title: Persian Stuffed Cucumber Boats
description: A refreshing and flavorful vegetarian dish featuring cucumber boats filled with a delicious mix of roasted vegetables.
instructions: 2. Cut the tops off the cucumbers and scoop out the insides, leaving a shell about 1/4 inch thick.
3. In a bowl, combine the chopped roast, argentinian persian, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
4. Stuff each cucumber boat with the vegetable mix.
5. Place the stuffed cucumbers on a baking sheet and roast for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
6. Garnish with chopped cucumber and serve.
